title: isGrafanaDevMode lives in its own leaf module
answers: How do I mock dev-mode checks in plugin extension tests?
Why can't I import isGrafanaDevMode from utils.tsx anymore?
body: isGrafanaDevMode was extracted out of public/app/features/plugins/extensions/utils.tsx into its own leaf file public/app/features/plugins/extensions/isGrafanaDevMode.ts to avoid utils.tsx pulling in @grafana/runtime eagerly and creating an import cycle. Import it from './isGrafanaDevMode', not from './utils'. Tests that need to stub dev mode must `jest.mock('./isGrafanaDevMode', () => ({ isGrafanaDevMode: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(false) }))` instead of mocking './utils' or mutating config.buildInfo.env directly (see usePluginComponent.test.tsx, usePluginComponents.test.tsx, validateExtensionPoint.test.ts).
applies: public/app/features/plugins/extensions/** — anything checking Grafana dev mode
